description: Storm risk for a place or coordinate, 0 to 1, with the reading behind it: wind, gusts, precipitation, sea state, the nearest named cyclone, and a band across 51 ECMWF ensemble members. 0.75 is the line a parametric cover pays on. Accepts a place name, a whole question naming one, or "lat,lon".

hours.description: Hours ahead, 0 to 168. Omit to read it from the question, or 0 for now.

place.description: A place name, a question naming one, or "lat,lon".

name: storm_risk
